WITH data AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_startups,
    SUM(turnover) AS total_turnover,
    SUM(profit) AS total_profit,
    SUM(employees_gp) AS total_employees,
    SUM(total_budget_payments) AS total_budget_payments,

    -- Previous values for reference
    SUM(previous_turnover) AS total_previous_turnover,
    SUM(previous_profit) AS total_previous_profit,
    SUM(previous_employees_gp) AS total_previous_employees,
    SUM(previous_total_budget_payments) AS total_previous_budget_payments
  FROM
    startups.data
), aggregated_data AS (
  SELECT
    total_startups,
    total_turnover,
    total_profit,
    total_employees,
    total_budget_payments,

    CASE
      WHEN total_previous_turnover IS NOT NULL AND total_previous_turnover != 0
        AND ABS((total_turnover - total_previous_turnover) / total_previous_turnover) >= 0.01
      THEN (total_turnover - total_previous_turnover) / total_previous_turnover
      ELSE NULL
    END AS turnover_delta_percent,

    CASE
      WHEN total_previous_profit IS NOT NULL AND total_previous_profit != 0
        AND ABS((total_profit - total_previous_profit) / total_previous_profit) >= 0.01
      THEN (total_profit - total_previous_profit) / total_previous_profit
      ELSE NULL
    END AS profit_delta_percent,

    CASE
      WHEN total_previous_employees IS NOT NULL AND total_previous_employees != 0
        AND ABS((total_employees - total_previous_employees) / total_previous_employees) >= 0.01
      THEN (total_employees - total_previous_employees) / total_previous_employees
      ELSE NULL
    END AS employees_delta_percent,

    CASE
      WHEN total_previous_budget_payments IS NOT NULL AND total_previous_budget_payments != 0
        AND ABS((total_budget_payments - total_previous_budget_payments) / total_previous_budget_payments) >= 0.01
      THEN (total_budget_payments - total_previous_budget_payments) / total_previous_budget_payments
      ELSE NULL
    END AS budget_payments_delta_percent
  FROM
    data
)
SELECT
  *
FROM
  aggregated_data
